$comment: What the installer renders. Requirement 10: a skill installs because a
path names it, or because a trial row says it is on trial. Cohesion
decides what a path names; `sd skill list --usage` shows the recorded use.
Each path is a pipeline that can be named end to end. A skill rides on a
path because the path would be broken without it, never because it is
adjacent to one. Everything else is in contrib/, in git and not installed,
where `sd skill try <name>` brings it back for thirty days and use decides.
A directory under skills/ that no path names fails `make check`. The list
is enumerated at install, never recited: this file is the enumeration.
